Interface ZeroCopyHttpOutputMessage

All Superinterfaces:
HttpMessage, ReactiveHttpOutputMessage
public interface ZeroCopyHttpOutputMessage extends ReactiveHttpOutputMessage
ReactiveOutputMessage 的子接口，支持“零拷贝”文件传输。

5.0
Author:
